verdict.rationale: Xero documents bill capture by upload or email forwarding, with AI extraction into draft bills 'ready for approval'. It also supports paying multiple bills in one go by exporting a payment file to online banking, after which the bills are marked as paid. Approval routing is only implied, and payment execution depends on uploading a file to the bank rather than an in-product scheduled payment. missing for 10: documented multi-step approval routing/approver assignment, payment scheduling for future dates, in-product payment execution without external bank upload, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Automate bill entry by uploading files directly to Xero or forwarding bills from your email. Xero's AI extracts the key details to create draft bills ready for approval.
Export a payment file from Xero and upload it directly to your online banking to pay multiple bills in one go.
Pay multiple bills at once and automate reconciliation ensuring records are always up-to-date.
